title: stylosanthes guianensis
intro: Stylosanthes guianensis, commonly known as the Guiana Stylo, is a plant species in the legume family, known for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The plant is used to treat various health issues, including fever, respiratory problems, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include reducing fever, soothing coughs, and treating skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Stylosanthes guianensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
